spec.name: M7.Presentation.record_eta
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), M7.Presentation.mk (M7.Presentation.outer a) (M7.Presentation.left a) (M7.Presentation.right a) = a
spec.guidance: The nested Lex synonym has the same underlying product. Destructure both pairs or use rfl after cases. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.record_mono
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (k : κ) (s s1 : σ) (t t1 : τ), s ≤ s1 → t ≤ t1 → M7.Presentation.mk k s t ≤ M7.Presentation.mk k s1 t1
spec.guidance: Use Prod.Lex.toLex_le_toLex or its partial-order variant twice. Equal outer coordinate reduces to the inner lex order; weak coordinate inequalities imply lex weak order. This proves that independent coordinate minima give the least pair. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.candidates_sound
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (L : κ → Finset σ) (R : κ → Finset τ) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), a ∈ M7.Presentation.candidates K L R → M7.Presentation.valid K L R a
spec.guidance: Unfold candidates; Finset.mem_biUnion identifies the outer k; split the nonempty test. Singleton equality identifies a with the two independent min values, whose membership follows from Finset.min'_mem. No product traversal is in candidates. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.candidate_dominates
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (L : κ → Finset σ) (R : κ → Finset τ) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), M7.Presentation.valid K L R a → ∃ b ∈ M7.Presentation.candidates K L R, b ≤ a
spec.guidance: Use the outer coordinate of a, witnessing both fibers nonempty by its coordinates. Choose the candidate of their separate min' values; membership in candidates is direct. min'_le and record_mono give b≤mk(outer a)(left a)(right a), then record_eta. spec.name: M7.Presentation.leastOf_spec
spec.statement: ∀ (α : Type) [LinearOrder α] (T : Finset α), (∀ x, M7.Presentation.leastOf T = some x ↔ x ∈ T ∧ ∀ y ∈ T, x ≤ y) ∧ (M7.Presentation.leastOf T = none ↔ T = ∅)
spec.guidance: Split T.Nonempty in leastOf; Finset.min'_mem/min'_le give soundness. Conversely uniqueness of the minimum follows by le_antisymm. Empty case uses Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty. Handle proof-irrelevance of nonempty witnesses normally. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.factorLeast_spec
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (L : κ → Finset σ) (R : κ → Finset τ) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), M7.Presentation.factorLeast K L R = some a ↔ M7.Presentation.valid K L R a ∧ ∀ b, M7.Presentation.valid K L R b → a ≤ b
spec.guidance: Forward: leastOf candidate min is valid; any valid b is bounded below by a candidate c, so a≤c≤b. Reverse: choose a candidate c≤a from candidate_dominates; validity and global minimality give a≤c, hence equality and a is a candidate, then leastOf_spec. The full preimage is only a semantic predicate, never enumerated in factorLeast. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.factorLeast_none
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (L : κ → Finset σ) (R : κ → Finset τ), M7.Presentation.factorLeast K L R = none ↔ ¬ ∃ a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ, M7.Presentation.valid K L R a
spec.guidance: leastOf none iff candidates empty. Any valid record yields a candidate, and any candidate is valid; combine the two implications. Covers empty outer domain and every empty single-block fiber. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.domain_membership
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ : Type) (K : Finset κ) (S : Finset σ) (T : Finset τ) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), a ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T ↔ M7.Presentation.outer a ∈ K ∧ M7.Presentation.left a ∈ S ∧ M7.Presentation.right a ∈ T
spec.guidance: Unfold domain and use biUnion/image/product membership. In the reverse direction choose the actual two coordinates and record_eta. This domain enumerates action records for selection, permitted by the original source; factorLeast never calls it. spec.name: M7.Presentation.targetLeast_spec
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ X Y : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (S : Finset σ) (T : Finset τ) (l : κ → σ → X) (r : κ → τ → Y) (q : X × Y), (∀ a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ, M7.Presentation.targetLeast K S T l r q = some a ↔ a ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T ∧ M7.Presentation.realize l r a = q ∧ ∀ b ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T, M7.Presentation.realize l r b = q → a ≤ b) ∧ (M7.Presentation.targetLeast K S T l r q = none ↔ ¬ ∃ a ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T, M7.Presentation.realize l r a = q)
spec.guidance: Instantiate factorLeast with the separately filtered left and right image fibers. Prove their valid predicate iff domain membership and equality of the realized pair using Prod.ext and filter membership. Then rewrite the two accepted exact factorLeast results; do not add a Cartesian scan to the algorithm definition. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.winning_fiber
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ X Y : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (S : Finset σ) (T : Finset τ) (l : κ → σ → X) (r : κ → τ → Y) (m : ℕ) (feasible : X × Y → Prop) (objective : X × Y → Fin m → ℤ) (mode : M7.Selection.Mode) (a b : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), a ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T → b ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T → M7.Presentation.realize l r a = M7.Presentation.realize l r b → (a ∈ M7.Presentation.selected K S T l r feasible objective mode ↔ b ∈ M7.Presentation.selected K S T l r feasible objective mode)
spec.guidance: The actual selected definition invokes M7.Selection.select. Use accepted selector_exact or unfold the literal win predicate. Feasibility and every objective coordinate depend on realize, so equal images give identical comparisons. No free Win-invariance or correctness oracle is assumed. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.presentation_exact
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ X Y : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (S : Finset σ) (T : Finset τ) (l : κ → σ → X) (r : κ → τ → Y) (m : ℕ) (feasible : X × Y → Prop) (objective : X × Y → Fin m → ℤ) (mode : M7.Selection.Mode) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), a ∈ M7.Presentation.selected K S T l r feasible objective mode → ∃! b : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ, M7.Presentation.present K S T l r feasible objective mode b ∧ M7.Presentation.realize l r b = M7.Presentation.realize l r a
spec.guidance: A winning a lies in domain by actual selector_exact. targetLeast at its image cannot be none by targetLeast_spec; obtain its unique least preimage b. It is winning by winning_fiber, so present. Any other present record with the same image yields the same targetLeast Option value, hence equality. This is every tied physical presentation exactly once. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.

spec.name: M7.Presentation.presentation_sound
spec.statement: ∀ (κ σ τ X Y : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (S : Finset σ) (T : Finset τ) (l : κ → σ → X) (r : κ → τ → Y) (m : ℕ) (feasible : X × Y → Prop) (objective : X × Y → Fin m → ℤ) (mode : M7.Selection.Mode) (a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ), M7.Presentation.present K S T l r feasible objective mode a → a ∈ M7.Presentation.selected K S T l r feasible objective mode ∧ a ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T ∧ ∀ b ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T, M7.Presentation.realize l r b = M7.Presentation.realize l r a → a ≤ b
spec.guidance: Unfold present. Its first conjunct is actual winning membership; its concrete targetLeast equality gives domain membership and minimality via targetLeast_spec. All returned presentations are winners and the least action preimage. Return tactic proof lines without leading by; preserve exact target and default limits.
